basic_profile.bio: A recent graduate from the University of Illinois with a degree in Computer Science, currently based in Chicago. Passionate about gaming and virtual reality, and working as a junior software developer at a mid-sized tech firm. Enjoys exploring new technologies, and learning about product management and customer success strategies. Typically online during evenings and weekends. In a relationship.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Has a solid foundation in computer science principles gained through a bachelor's degree. Actively learning about VR development and game design independently through online courses and forums. Gaining practical experience in software development at work, focusing on troubleshooting and debugging.
